questions.text: Which book argues that the real problem with hookup culture is not promiscuity but the way purity ethics are used to police young women's sexuality?
questions.explanation: "The Purity Myth" is a feminist critique of abstinence-only education and the moral panic around hookup culture, while Jessica Valenti's other works include "Full Frontal Feminism" and "Why Have Kids?"

questions.text: Which 2009 film features a male lead whose professional life revolves around giving advice on casual hookups and dating?
questions.explanation: In the 2009 film 'The Ugly Truth', the male lead character is a TV producer who uses the premise of hookups and casual dating advice as a professional angle, making it a central location/setting for the film's commentary on hookup culture.
